scope: Independent local research; no application code or rendering implementation.
sample_origin: Locally inspected packages obtained by the separately authorized research fetcher; this audit itself makes no network or phone calls.

sources.offset_convention: All disassembly offsets are absolute byte offsets in the named uncompressed DEX entry, not method-relative.

body_fields.color: resolved integer converted to a string

request.version_correction: Previous earbud-artwork resource-contract/probe_resources used manifest versionCode. The APK request reads application meta-data.versionCode: H 17006004, O 17006002; do not use H 117006005 or O 17006003.
request.response: Plain JSON code/msg/data envelope. data is one resource object with fileName/resourceUrl/resourceName/resourceDescription/sha256; ZIP bytes are downloaded from resourceUrl.
request.authentication: Existing verified request-body HMAC-SHA1 chain; no secret or signed header materials are persisted in this evidence.

model_configuration.verified_outer_config: Both successful samples contain model3D.path = res/raw/detail_model.vfxms and omit modelWebp.
model_configuration.path_to_ui: O LF8/d.invoke at 0x1378c8/0x13790a reads model3D/modelWebp; resolves under rootPath, rejects directories, then sets modelFilePath at 0x1378fc and webpFilePath at 0x13793e.
model_configuration.ui_fallback: O MelodyDetailModelView.d code 0x29cfdc: usable supported 3D at 0x29d068; otherwise modelWebp at 0x29d0ae; otherwise detail picture at 0x29d0dc; otherwise placeholder. Availability also depends on host performance and SDK/library readiness.
model_configuration.builtin_config_facts: All three PIDs have support3DModel=1 and no defaultColor in both authenticated local APK whitelist snapshots.

color_resolution.behavior: Explicit input other than -1 is preserved. Unknown -1 uses whitelist defaultColor when not -1; absent default only realme has fallback 0 with SPP or 1 without SPP. These OPPO models retain -1 when no actual device color is supplied.
color_resolution.source_boundary: The API expects a protocol/device color integer, not an RGB value or retail color label. Live-device color acquisition is outside this isolated artifact audit.

vfxms.byte_order: big endian signed int32 header, confirmed against both actual samples
vfxms.offset_semantics: Head.read records all start/length pairs. ModelScene.loadSceneFromBuffer consumes config/GLB/IBL/skybox sequentially using lengths and does not seek to recorded starts. The offline parser verifies both declared bounds and sequential bounds and records any start disagreement.
vfxms.header_animation: Read into Head, but not consumed by the traced loadSceneFromBuffer. Offline report retains these fields and records unconsumed tail; original container is never deleted or modified.
vfxms.encryption: No AES or decompression stage exists in this APK file-loading chain. Both actual samples expose readable JSON, GLB and KTX directly after the 40-byte header. This does not assert the format of every future server package.

offline_parser.output_location: Each input run/model-inspection; all resolved paths confined to this independent research directory.
offline_parser.exports: Original unchanged scene-config.json UTF-8 bytes, GLB bytes, IBL KTX bytes and skybox KTX bytes when present.
checks: all declared and sequential section bounds
strict scene JSON: duplicate keys and nonfinite numeric values rejected
GLB2 magic/declared length/chunk bounds/alignment/first JSON/unique JSON and BIN/asset.version
KTX1 2D/cubemap headers and all mipmap face ranges/final length
KTX2 header and level/metadata bounds only; codecs not executed
original source SHA256 rechecked after export
offline_parser.limitations: No rendering, shader/native code execution, texture decoding, mesh accessor semantics, external URI loading, 3D/array KTX1 support or animation interpretation.

verified_samples.color_interpretation: This successful server color value and internal scene name do not establish the complete color enumeration or an official retail color name.
